newsitem.title: USA: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks rose 94 bcf.
newsitem.headline: AGA says U.S. weekly natgas stocks rose 94 bcf.

text.p: American Gas Association estimates of U.S. working gas in storage in billion cubic feet

Notes: (1) Incl Texas, Okla., Kansas, N.Mexico, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Miss. (2) Incl states east of Miss. River less Miss., plus Iowa, Neb and Missouri (3) Incl states west of the Miss. River less producing region and Iowa, Neb and Missouri.
Survey sample and full working gas estimates
- Survey Sample Est. Full Work- Yr-Ago

Notes: (4) Ratio of max WG vol. to est. of highest WG in storage in past 2 yrs (EIA).(5) Highest WG level by state added to give regional and national levels (EIA).(6) Regional and total vols divided by est.full regional and total vols.

AGA said one company with underground storage operations in both the Producing and Consuming East regions has temporarily withdrawn from the American Gas Storage Survey. For this week, the change in sample size has had little or no effect on the results in the Consuming East region. For the Producing region, as much as 1 (one) Bcf per day of the net increase for the week ended Oct 4 may be attributable to the subsequent change in sample size, AGA said.
